title: The Conductor-21 L-Function: Certified Zeros, Exact Laws, and a Density-Prime Operator - verification deposit
description: Verification artifact for the Conductor-21 (chi_8 / PSL(2,7) genome) L-function program. Contains the certificate packages behind each claim of the paper's Appendix C map, the reusable engines (Appendix C.2), a consolidated SHA256SUMS, and verify_deposit.py. Code is MIT-licensed; data (bracket tables, certification scans, the certified spectrum) is CC BY 4.0. Every 8-hex certificate prefix cited in Appendix C resolves against this deposit.
